Aisha (CEO): Quick Friday founders' roundup — 3 min read. Highlights and asks for next week.

Aisha (CEO): TL;DR: growth ticked up, P0 reliability item mitigated, product rollout delayed 1 week. Asks below.

Aisha (CEO): Metrics: signups +22% MoM, avg token latency 160ms (p50), cost/unit down ~9% after batch tuning. Net retention steady at 78%.

Aisha (CEO): Decisions: 1) Prioritize Dedicated capacity on EU region (security + sales ask). 2) Move forward with private beta for v2 caching layer. 3) Delay Canary for chat-multimodel by 7 days to finish QA.

Marco (VP Eng): Thanks — infra nailed the P0 cache eviction bug yesterday. Full rollback plan ready if we regress. :thumbsup:

Ben (Head of Infra): Incident note: 2026-03-21 03:14 UTC — mem leak in batching worker. Hotfix deployed at 04:05 UTC; 4% request drop for 45m. Root cause: mutex not released when kernel fallback triggered. Tracking postmortem.

Priya (CPO): Product update: moving roadmap milestone 'structured outputs' to next sprint; will keep the tokenizer/refinement work. Need eng help for eval harness by Tue.

Nora (Head of Ops): FYI — compliance team signed off on SOC2 scope expansion. Next steps: update runbooks and console audit retention to 13 months.

Sam (Finance): Quick ask: can we freeze new non-critical hiring until we close the Q2 forecast? Expect headcount plan by Mon.

Aisha (CEO): Asks: - Marco/BEN: share postmortem draft by EOD Mon. - Priya: eval harness ETA Tue. - Nora/Sam: updated runbook + headcount notes to me by Wed.

Aisha (CEO): Thanks team. Good work on reliability. Short week next week — let's keep async updates in this thread. Link to metrics: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/weekly-metrics (internal)

deploy-bot: Deployment `release-2026.03.21.4` rolled to staged at 2026-03-21T05:00Z

Marco (VP Eng): Noted. I'll post a quick follow-up with the rollback thresholds and SLA impact numbers.

Ben (Head of Infra): Will attach logs & timeline to the postmortem doc. :spiral_note_pad:

Priya (CPO): I'll allocate a PM to help with eval harness. Thanks.

Nora (Head of Ops): Copy. Saving this thread for exec sync.

Sam (Finance): Sending the draft forecast now.
